title: Treaty of Medina del Campo (1431)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Medina del Campo (1431)", at revision 1359756384, opens: "The Treaty of Medina del Campo was signed on 30 October 1431. It was a peace treaty between the Crown of Castile and the Kingdom of Portugal. The agreement was ratified in Almeirim in January 1432." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5023728, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1431 peace treaty between Castile and Portugal". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
